How to get your Manager ID ?
Note: Manager ID will be automatically extracted from the API if not provided.
1. Log in to https://fantasy.premierleague.com/
2. Access your team: Navigate to either the "Pick Team" or "Points" section.
3. Check the URL: Look at the address bar of your browser.
You'll see a URL similar to this: https://fantasy.premierleague.com/entry/1234567/event/1.
The number after /entry/ and before /event/ (in this case, 1234567) is your FPL ID, according to several FPL resources.
How to get your FPL Refresh Token (only needed once)?
Note: Without a token, only public data (summary, history, leagues) is synced.
1. Log in to https://fantasy.premierleague.com/ and open the developer tools (Ctrl+Shift+I or F12)
2. Go to the Console tab and run (type "allow pasting" first if Chrome blocks it):
copy(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(Object.keys(localStorage).find(k=>k.startsWith('oidc.user:')))).refresh_token)
3. Paste the copied value in the field above. Odoo refreshes the token automatically afterwards.
